Client Confidence Rating 2025, Regional Advisor Review: that's the badge at the top of every page on our site. The date the rating was given, the period it covers, and the compensation details sit in the footer at the bottom of the page, in smaller type than the badge, and the footer reads: given March 2026 for the 2025 calendar year by Regional Advisor Review, a publication that rates advisers every year; no fee was paid to be considered and nothing is paid to display it.
